subject: P6-H1: Cursor gate bridge (write-gate + lifecycle hooks)
description: Implement the Cursor adapter bridge: write-gate hook (preToolUse exit-2 against /active-claim), session registration (sessionStart → /workspace), agent lifecycle (subagentStart/Stop → /agent/start|done), stop advisory (preToolUse → /should-stop). Try Claude compat layer first (.claude/settings.json); fall back to native .cursor/hooks.json if payload mapping requires it. Document IDE-vs-CLI gaps.
